Order 
17.11.2023 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
01.
1. This is an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Dharambandha P.S. Case No.20 of 2019 corresponding to C.T. Case No.180 of 2019, pending in the file of the learned S.D.J.M., Nuapada under Sections 420, 467, 468 of IPC.
2. The prayer for bail of the petitioner had been rejected by order dated 19.10.2023 passed by the learned Addl. District and Sessions Judge, Nuapada in BLAPL No.119/60 of 2023.
3. Perusal of the rejection order dated 19.10.2023 reveals that investigation was in progress.
4. Considering the fact that the petitioner could not be arrested for a period of three years, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail at this stage.
